description: XSUAA security descriptor for the Ticket-CAP performance dashboard. Defines the six business roles used by the CAP backend's permission engine.

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Admin
scopes.description: Full administrative access (audit logs, reference data, user management)

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Manager
scopes.description: Project manager — approve tickets, manage deliverables, validate timesheets

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.ProjectManager
scopes.description: Project manager — same elevated permissions as Manager scoped to a project

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.DevCoordinator
scopes.description: Dev coordinator — create tickets, allocate consultants, manage WRICEFs

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.ConsultantTechnique
scopes.description: Technical consultant — execute assigned tickets, log time, attach deliverables

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.ConsultantFonctionnel
scopes.description: Functional consultant — create tickets, run functional tests, manage own feedback

role-collections.name: TicketCap_Admin
role-collections.description: Full administrator of the Ticket-CAP application
